not_found: operating_profit: not printed in the managing company report (only profit_before_tax per segment); the deck definition (management fees less selling/marketing less G&A) has to be computed downstream. The printed income statement shows the components.

net_transfers: printed only inside the narrative of the directors' report (section "שינויים עיקריים", per fund, in NIS millions, rounded), not in a table; not extracted. transfers_in and transfers_out are extracted from the tables.
aum_average and transfers_between_tracks: not printed as figures in the tables.
withdrawals: only פדיונות is printed per fund type; payments to pensioners by type (old age / disability / survivors) are not extracted, total_payments (סה"כ תשלומים, נטו) is.
investment_contracts segment (חוזי השקעה): not applicable to a managing company of pension and provident funds.
dac_amortisation: the interim report prints only the cash-flow line "שינוי בהוצאות רכישה נדחות" (net movement), not the amortisation split; dac_amortisation is available from the annual reports only.

Fund-type flows (deposits, transfers, withdrawals, fees from assets/deposits, fee rates, new business) are printed for the cumulative period only (six / nine months), not for the standalone quarter; the standalone quarter appears in the income statement and the segment note (window q).
notes: Source: the managing company's own report (מגדל מקפת קרנות פנסיה וקופות גמל בע"מ), downloaded from the Migdal website (my.migdal.co.il/makefet/financal-reports and the media links of that site); the listed parent (מגדל אחזקות) was not used. Amounts in NIS thousand as printed; members in persons (pension funds) or member accounts (provident funds) per the report footnote; fee rates in percent as printed.

Per-fund-type tables (directors' report "ריכוז תוצאות הפעילות" in the business description of the annual reports): fund_type gives the column. segment pension_new = קרנות פנסיה חדשות (comprehensive = מקפת אישית and general = מקפת משלימה are separate columns; no combined figure is printed in that table), pension_veteran = קרן פנסיה ותיקה מקיפה (יוזמה), provident = קופות גמל: other_provident_funds (מגדל מרכזית לפיצויים, מקפת דמי מחלה, מקפת תקציבית), child_savings (קופ"ג להשקעה לחסכון ארוך טווח לילד), investment_provident (קופ"ג להשקעה), study_fund (קרן השתלמות incl. IRA track), provident_savings_compensation (קופ"ג לתגמולים ואישית לפיצויים incl. IRA track). segment total = column "סה"כ" (pension + provident). Columns were assigned by x-position on the page and cross-checked: the sum of the eight fund columns equals the printed total column for every additive row, and each AUM row equals the "היקף הנכסים המנוהלים" by-fund table of the same report (all comparable dates, zero differences).

Windows: ytd = six months ended 30 June; q = the three months of Q2 (only in income statement and segment note); members and AUM are instant (balance date). Comparative columns printed in the report (prior-year period, prior year-end, and for annual reports two earlier years) are included with their own dates.

Income statement and segment note: segment pension = new pension funds + veteran fund; segment provident = all gemel (provident, study, central) funds; pension_new / pension_veteran from the supplementary table "נתונים נוספים לגבי מגזר פנסיה". selling_and_marketing_expenses = line "עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות", which includes the net deferred-acquisition-cost movement (capitalised commissions net of amortisation). other_expenses = amortisation of gemel management rights / intangible assets (printed as its own line, gemel segment only). Operating profit is not printed; profit_before_tax is.

Sign convention: values exactly as printed; outflows printed in parentheses (transfers out, withdrawals, payments, DAC amortisation) are negative. Cells printed as a dash (nil) and cells printed "ל.ר" (not relevant) are not recorded as facts.

Management fees in the by-type tables: management_fees_from_assets (דמי ניהול שנגבו מנכסים) split active+inactive members / pension recipients / total; management_fees_from_deposits (דמי ניהול שנגבו מהפקדות). Pension: assets-based + deposit-based fees by fund equal the segment management_fees in the note (checked for 2024Q3: 189,125 + 128,115 = 317,240).
The PDF file name on the Migdal site ("migdal-insurance-..."), is the managing-company report of Migdal Makefet (title page and content checked).
